item.title: Caroline County Native Russell McCoy Jr.
item.description: In this powerful episode of Black Fredericksburg Radio, we sit down with Russell McKoy Jr., creator of the Trailer 2 Treasure movement. A Caroline County native, Russell shares his journey from being labeled and limited by learning challenges in school to becoming a nationally traveling motivational speaker and gut health entrepreneur. item.title: Community Conversations with the Fredericksburg Area Kappa Foundation
item.description: In this episode of Community Conversations, we sit down with the Brothas of the Kappa League Foundation of Fredericksburg to talk about their upcoming Basketball Tournament & Toy Drive, along with their elegant New Year’s Eve Fundraiser supporting local families. Tune in for an inspiring look at how these young leaders are uplifting the community through service, mentorship, and meaningful events.

item.title: Meet Life Coach Cynthia Perry
item.description: In this episode of Community Conversations, Cynthia Perry shares the inspiration behind Exes and Ohs! A Gathering for Women and discusses the importance of creating safe, supportive spaces for women navigating life before, during, and after divorce.

item.title: AKA Psi Psi Omega Scholarship Program
item.description: Calling all high school seniors and continuing college students in Stafford and Fauquier Counties! 💚🩷 Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated® Psi Psi Omega Chapter is offering several scholarship opportunities to help students continue their educational journey. Scholarship amounts range from $1,500 to $2,000, and the extended application deadline is April 13, 2026. Recipients will be notified by May 4, 2026.
